summary: Iteration 22 — Final UI consistency verification pass (frontend only). VERDICT: ONE CRITICAL REGRESSION FOUND on Collections empty state. Everything else passes. Tested at 390x844 (mobile) and 900x1000 (tablet) against the live preview URL, exercising both the guest flow and the seeded bearer (test-session-token-aura-123 → user_testaura01). Details per feature: (1) Home — weather chip (29°C · Clear sky), greeting, home-weather-suggestion, growBanner (16 items), home-dress-me-button hero, Recent Outfits (5 cards for seeded user / ghost-empty for guest), all four home-qa-* Quick Actions render correctly. (2) Profile — NEW EDITORIAL HEADER RENDERS as spec'd: kicker 'YOUR ACCOUNT' + Semibold 'Profile' + subtitle 'Your wardrobe, insights and preferences — all in one place.' Account card (avatar 60x60 sage, name, badge Guest mode/Premium/Free), metric row (Pieces / Looks / Profiles), profile-switcher-trigger with 'Active wardrobe' label, guest-backup-cta (guest-only), open-style-profile, open-beauty, profile-calendar-cta, profile-premium-cta, open-health-report, find-missing-button — every CTA rendered with consistent border/radius/spacing. Logout icon correctly hidden for guests and shown for seeded (Premium) user. Wardrobe switcher modal opens, lists profiles, and shows new-profile-input + add-profile-button. (3) Dress Me — editorial header 'YOUR DAILY EDIT' + 'Dress Me' + subtitle renders. Error state 'Not enough ready-to-wear items…' with 'Create Another Look' retry CTA renders correctly (seeded user has 0 items so no positive outfit render was possible in this pass — no code bug). Header/kicker/type/hierarchy consistent with Home + Profile. (4) Collections list — top bar back/title/plus, create-collection modal opens with collection-name-input + collection-create-confirm and works. (5) Collections EMPTY STATE — BROKEN (see below). (6) Add-item photoless guard — save-item-button with no photo shows 'Add a photo of the item before saving.' correctly, save is blocked. (7) Responsive grids at 900px — no horizontal overflow anywhere (document.scrollWidth == clientWidth == 900) across Home / Wardrobe / Outfits / Collections. useWindowDimensions is wired on outfits.tsx, wardrobe.tsx, collection/[id].tsx, item/[id].tsx, collections.tsx. (8) Global Inter typography — consistent Semibold headers, kickers (letter-spacing 1.5–2), spacing scale 8/12/16/24/32; no broken routes; only pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings in console (shadow*, pointerEvents) inherited from prior iterations. ONE 400 network error during DressMe load for seeded user — expected, backend returns 400 because seeded user has 0 items.

ui_bugs.issue: The empty-state JSX in /app/frontend/app/collections.tsx (lines 52–63) references style keys `emptyWrap`, `emptyHeading`, `emptyCopy`, `ghostRow`, `ghostCard`, `ghostCreate`, `ghostPlus`, `ghostCreateTxt` — NONE of which exist in the StyleSheet.create() block below (the StyleSheet only defines `empty`, `emptyIcon`, `emptyTitle`, `emptySub`, `emptyCta`, `emptyCtaTxt`). Result: at 390x844 the empty state renders as a raw, top-aligned, unstyled block of text (heading, body copy, 'New collection' text next to two loose folder/grid glyphs) — no card layout, no centering, no ghost-card grid, no sage 'plus' badge, no borders/radii/backgrounds/padding. Regression is visible at BOTH 390px and 900px viewports. This directly contradicts the review acceptance criterion: 'Collections tab: empty state renders correctly'.

issues: Empty-state ghost-card grid + create CTA render unstyled due to missing StyleSheet keys — see ui_bugs above.

action_items: Main agent: add the missing StyleSheet entries to /app/frontend/app/collections.tsx — `emptyWrap`, `emptyHeading`, `emptyCopy`, `ghostRow`, `ghostCard`, `ghostCreate`, `ghostPlus`, `ghostCreateTxt` — to match the ghost-card empty state used on Home (see /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx `ghostRow`/`ghostCard`/`ghostCreate`/`ghostPlus`/`ghostCreateTxt` for the exact editorial pattern to mirror). Consider extracting the ghost-card empty state into a shared component so Home + Collections + any future empty states stay visually identical.

Optional: consider re-seeding user_testaura01 with a handful of ready-to-wear items so future automated Dress Me tests can generate a positive outfit (currently the seeded user has 0 items, so /api/dressme returns 400 with 'Not enough ready-to-wear items' and no flatlay/weather-chip/save-outfit path can be visually verified for this account).
critical_code_review_comments: collections.tsx: unused StyleSheet keys (`empty`, `emptyIcon`, `emptyTitle`, `emptySub`, `emptyCta`, `emptyCtaTxt`) — leftover from a prior empty-state design. Delete these once the missing keys above are added, otherwise the file will accumulate dead style keys.

useWeather.ts: DEFAULT fallback silently uses London coordinates when both geolocation and IP lookup fail. This is fine for the web preview but consider surfacing a subtle indicator (e.g. italicised city name) so users on a broken network know the tip is generic — currently the UI treats the London fallback as if it were their real location.

rca_of_issue: Collections empty state was recently redesigned (from a single centred CTA with icon → to a horizontal ghost-card grid to match Home). The JSX was updated to reference the new class names but the StyleSheet.create() block was never updated — the old styles (`empty`, `emptyIcon`, `emptyTitle`, `emptySub`, `emptyCta`, `emptyCtaTxt`) still exist but are now orphaned, and the new keys never made it in. React Native / RN-Web silently ignores undefined style refs so there is no red screen, just a visually unstyled block. Reproduction (all 3 steps required): (1) Fresh guest via [data-testid=guest-login-button] (or any account with zero collections); (2) navigate to /collections; (3) observe the empty state. Fix: append the missing keys to the StyleSheet, or better, extract into a shared <EmptyGhostRow/> component consumed by both Home and Collections.
